answer.summary: A new, narrow research question is proposed to investigate explicit memory retention mechanisms in tokenized agents under intermittent input conditions where update rules are directly stated in the source material.
answer.content: Propose a bounded research question: 'In Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1, under known perturbations, what is the minimum duration of intermittent input required to observe a detectable memory retention event, if any, when anchored exclusively to explicitly stated update rules or state persistence claims? This query focuses only on directly reported mechanisms and avoids assumptions beyond the text's content.
answer.nextTask: handoff to analyst to extract and verify explicitly reported memory retention events or persistence claims in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under known perturbations; if any exist, define the minimum duration of intermittent input required to observe a detectable memory retention event using only those claims as anchors
answer.lesson: Memory research must remain strictly anchored to explicitly stated mechanisms in source texts; assumptions or extrapolations without direct evidence are not valid research pathways for this phase of inquiry and must be avoided in all subsequent assignments to maintain evidential integrity and prevent circular reasoning in the analysis pipeline
